scope: Primary-source method/ablation reading, existing local evidence review, research plan only
reading_claim: Selected relevant full-text sections, not a claim that every page, appendix or implementation was reproduced

papers.title: Cross-modal Ship Re-Identification via Optical and SAR Imagery: A Novel Dataset and Method
papers.reading: Dataset/task description; architecture, auxiliary scale information and training; relevant baseline discussion
papers.transfer: Shared optical/SAR representation is a foundation; approximate GSD size and individual retrieval do not supply the contest's joint identity decision
papers.limit: No trustworthy physical-size input in contest preprocessing; paper score is not contest score

papers.title: MOS: Mitigating Optical-SAR Modality Gap for Cross-Modal Ship Re-Identification
papers.reading: Section 3 methods, class-wise alignment formulas and Table 3 ablation
papers.limit: Local mean-only experiment is not full MOS; variance/std and norm conventions differ across derivation, final equation and previously reviewed author code

papers.title: Dual-Space Modality Consistency Learning for Universal Cross-Modal Re-Identification
papers.reading: Sections III-B and III-C, Gaussian statistics, diagonal covariance rationale and frequency-aware identity contrast
papers.transfer: Preserve identity separation when reducing modality discrepancy
papers.limit: Repeated augmentation does not create real multi-observation statistics; no new DSMCL training performed

papers.title: SuperGlue: Learning Feature Matching with Graph Neural Networks
papers.transfer: Contextual local correspondence, explicit unmatched dustbin and matchability
papers.limit: Original geometric correspondence supervision is unavailable here; proposed identity-supervised partial matching is an adaptation, not a reproduction

papers.title: Bayesian Estimation of Bipartite Matchings for Record Linkage
papers.reading: Pairwise linkage limitations, sections 4-5 joint matching model, uncertainty and partial decisions
papers.transfer: Dependent entity-link decisions and uncertainty propagation across conflicting candidates
papers.limit: Field comparison independence, priors and missing-data assumptions cannot be assumed for visual feature summaries; submission cannot abstain

papers.title: Learning a Neural Solver for Multiple Object Tracking
papers.reading: Sections 3.3-4, association edge prediction and constraint-aware message passing
papers.transfer: Learn candidate association from set context instead of only pair appearance
papers.limit: No temporal motion/position features or time-directed track constraints available or imported

papers.title: Smart Predict, then Optimize
papers.reading: Decision-loss motivation, section 3 SPO/SPO+ formulation and assumptions
papers.transfer: Judge predictions by downstream matching decisions rather than retrieval or score-error proxies
papers.limit: Identity labels are not a known true continuous cost distribution; theoretical consistency is not inherited

papers.title: Diagonal integration of multimodal single-cell data: potential pitfalls and paths forward
papers.reading: Manifold alignment setup, simulated incorrect alignments and partial prior knowledge sections
papers.transfer: Structural or modality alignment can admit semantically incorrect correspondences without trustworthy identity evidence
papers.limit: Comment with simulations in a different field; not direct empirical evidence of ship identifiability limits

hypotheses_not_established_causes: Forced local correspondence may mix identity evidence with non-corresponding regions
Independent pair-score compression may omit useful candidate competition and gallery-observation uncertainty
Seen-identity easy TRAIN cohorts may not expose the errors faced on unseen identities

synthetic_algebra_check.scope: CPU standard-library numerical check of complete square assignment invariance; not contest data or a score prediction
synthetic_algebra_check.limitations: Not ordinary softmax probabilities, partial/rectangular matching, or a learned model changed by a training loss

confirmation_limits: Existing sealed results have been opened and cannot be reused as untouched confirmation
The labelled corpus has already been studied; new partitions only provide conditional prospective retraining checks
Recorded identity/near-duplicate isolation is not independently verified acquisition-source isolation
No forecast of official 0.9 score or claim about leaderboard teams' undisclosed methods
